analogy.rationale: Casein kinase inhibitors are ATP-competitive protein kinase inhibitors whose annotated targets overlap with AKT, CHK1, GSK3B, and MAP kinases, so other kinase inhibitors may share partial transcriptional signatures, but CK2 inhibition alone typically produces a modest, non-specific response in these cell lines.
